This companion website presents the reproducibility reports for the paper *Ease and Evidence: Visual Fluency in Screening*.
The [Reproducibility Report](reproducibility_reports/Reproducibility_Report.qmd) reproduces all results, tables, and figures of the paper and its appendix from the processed data, in the order of the paper.
Seven detailed reproducibility reports document how the raw data were processed and which participants and observations were excluded, and they report the full models and further analyses.

**Main report**

- [Reproducibility Report](reproducibility_reports/Reproducibility_Report.qmd)

**Detailed reproducibility reports**

1. [Manipulation Checks](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_1_MCs.qmd)
2. [LLM Ratings](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_2_LLM_Ratings.qmd)
3. [Deck Benchmarking](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_3_Benchmarking.qmd)
4. [Study 1: Investor Engagement in the Field](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_4_Field_Experiment.qmd)
5. [Studies 2A–2C: Investment Evaluation](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_5_Investment_Evaluation.qmd)
6. [Study 3: Attention and Investment Allocation](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_6_Attention_Investment.qmd)
7. [Study 4: Design Disclosure and an Explanation of Processing Ease](reproducibility_reports/Detailed_Report_7_Design_Disclosure.qmd)

All reports are created with R and Quarto. For readability, code is hidden by default and only the relevant results are shown. Use the <kbd></> Code</kbd> button (top-right) to view the complete source code of each report.

Everything you see on this website is fully reproducible from the project's [GitHub repository](https://github.com/visual-fluency/pitch-decks).
In addition, the preregistrations, detailed materials, data, and code for the entire project are available at the paper's [ResearchBox](https://researchbox.org/1836&PEER_REVIEW_passcode=NKVZFU).
